policies.label: Check-in / Check-out
policies.text: Check-in from 12 pm, check-out by 11 am. Early check-in and late check-out on request, subject to availability.

policies.label: Valid ID required
policies.text: Aadhaar, passport or driving licence — one valid photo ID per adult guest, as per government rules.

policies.label: Cancellation & refund
policies.text: Plans change — message us as early as you can and we will work it out with you. No cancellation fee when you book direct on WhatsApp.

policies.label: Payment modes
policies.text: Cash, UPI and cards accepted. Pay at the hotel — no advance needed for most bookings.

policies.label: Children & extra beds
policies.text: Children are welcome. Extra mattress on request — just tell us in your message.

policies.label: Pets
policies.text: Please ask us before bringing pets; we will do our best to help.

policies.label: Smoking
policies.text: No smoking indoors. Smoking is permitted in open areas only.

policies.label: Visitors
policies.text: Visitors are welcome to wait at the reception; room entry is for registered guests.

privacyNote: We only use your number to reply to your enquiry. We never share it or send spam.
